content.title: Electronic Invoice Generation (Hóa Đơn Điện Tử)
content.tldr: When an order reaches 'processing' state, the system automatically generates an Invoice with a unique immutable invoice number, calculates VAT subtotals per tax rate, and transitions the order to 'completed'. The invoice is compliant with Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC.
content.summary: Khi đơn hàng được xác nhận thanh toán, hệ thống tự động tạo hóa đơn điện tử với số hóa đơn duy nhất và bất biến, tính thuế VAT cho từng mức thuế suất. Hóa đơn tuân thủ Thông tư 78/2021/TT-BTC. Số hóa đơn không được phép thay đổi sau khi phát hành.

conditions: You only need the Invoice entity shape — read entity-registry.json
You are working on Order — the invoice is triggered by the order module

do_not: Do NOT allow invoice number to be changed after issuance — this violates Vietnamese tax law
Do NOT expose invoices from other stores
Do NOT allow manual invoice creation — invoices are only system-generated
Do NOT allow a completed order to have no invoice
Do NOT round VAT amounts — use integer arithmetic only (all values in đồng)
see_also: wiki/state-map.json → Invoice state machine (draft → issued → cancelled)

sections.heading: Invoice State Machine
sections.note: Invoice number is set at 'draft' creation and is immutable through all state changes.

sections.heading: Vietnamese Tax Compliance Rules
items: LEGAL-01: Invoice number (số hóa đơn) must be unique per seller (store). Format: {year}/{sequence} e.g. '2026/000001'
LEGAL-02: Invoice number is IMMUTABLE after creation — cannot be changed even if order is refunded
LEGAL-03: VAT is calculated per line item group by tax rate, then summed
LEGAL-04: Invoice must include: store name, taxCode, address, buyer info (optional for retail), issue date
LEGAL-05: Cancelled invoices retain their number — a cancellation record is issued, not a new invoice
LEGAL-06: All monetary values on invoice are integers in VNĐ — no decimal display
LEGAL-07: Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC governs electronic invoice format (simplified retail version for MVP)

items.i_want: to generate an invoice when an order is confirmed for payment
items.so_that: every completed sale has a legally compliant tax invoice
acceptance_criteria: Given order transitions to 'processing' — When order.processing event fires — Then invoice is created in 'draft' state with unique sequential number
Invoice includes: invoiceNumber, storeId, orderId, issuedAt, status, lines[], subtotals by tax rate, totalVnd
Invoice lines mirror OrderItems: productName (snapshot), sku (snapshot), quantity, unitPriceVnd, taxRatePercent, lineTotalVnd
After invoice is successfully created — order.status transitions to 'completed'
If invoice creation fails — order stays in 'processing', error is logged, retry is attempted
invoiceNumber format: '{YYYY}/{sequence:06d}' scoped per store — e.g. '2026/000001'
invoiceNumber sequence is monotonically increasing and gap-free per store
edge_cases: Two orders confirmed simultaneously for same store — invoice number sequence must not collide (DB-level sequence or pessimistic lock)
Store has issued 999999 invoices in a year — sequence rolls over to next year's prefix on Jan 1
business_rules: BR-INV-01: Invoice number is set once and immutable
BR-INV-02: Invoice sequence is per-store per-year
BR-INV-03: All product data on invoice is a snapshot from OrderItem — not live from Product table
BR-INV-04: VAT subtotals grouped by rate: { rate: 10, taxableVnd: X, vatVnd: Y }
BR-INV-05: vatVnd = floor(taxableVnd × taxRatePercent / 100) — integer arithmetic, floor rounding

items.i_want: to view the invoice for a completed order
items.so_that: I can show or print it for the customer
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed order — When GET /api/v1/orders/:id/invoice — Then 200 with full invoice
Given order is not completed (still pending/processing) — Then 404 'Invoice not yet issued'
Given caller's store does not match invoice's store — Then 404

items.i_want: to list all invoices for my store within a date range
items.so_that: I can reconcile monthly VAT for the tax authority
acceptance_criteria: Given valid accountant JWT — When GET /api/v1/invoices?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD — Then 200 paginated list
Results include: invoiceNumber, orderId, status, totalVnd, issuedAt, vatSubtotals
Given caller is cashier — Then 403 (invoices are not directly accessible by cashiers, only via order)
edge_cases: Date range spans month boundary — all invoices within ISO date range included
business_rules: BR-INV-06: Only accountant, store-manager, and admin can list invoices directly
BR-INV-07: Cashier accesses invoice through GET /orders/:id/invoice only

items.i_want: to cancel an issued invoice when a refund is approved
items.so_that: the accounting books correctly reflect the refund
acceptance_criteria: Given an issued invoice and an order in 'refunded' state — When PATCH /api/v1/invoices/:id/cancel — Then 200, invoice.status = 'cancelled'
Given invoice is already cancelled — Then 200 (idempotent)
Given order is NOT in 'refunded' state — When cancel invoice — Then 409 'Order must be refunded before cancelling invoice'
Invoice number is NOT changed on cancellation — it remains as the cancelled invoice's identifier
edge_cases: Refund approved but invoice cancellation fails — order is refunded but invoice stays 'issued' (logged as inconsistency, requires manual resolution)
business_rules: BR-INV-08: Invoice cancellation is only possible after order refund (Sprint 4 refund flow)
BR-INV-09: Cancelled invoice number is retained — a new '0-value' adjustment record may be required for tax authority (post-MVP)

example.note: vatVnd = floor(taxableVnd × rate / 100). All integers, no rounding errors.

items.question: Do we need to submit invoices to the Vietnamese tax authority portal (hệ thống hóa đơn điện tử of General Department of Taxation)?
items.default_decision: MVP stores invoices in DB only. External portal submission is a post-MVP integration.

items.question: Does the invoice need a digital signature (chữ ký số)?
items.default_decision: Digital signature deferred. MVP invoice is internally valid but not externally submitted.

items.question: PDF generation for printing?
items.default_decision: JSON only for MVP. PDF export in Sprint 4.

approval.notes: Approved at roadmap planning. MVP scope: internal invoice only, no external portal.
